questions.question_text:
Use $\begin{array}{c|cc} &\text{B1}&\text{B2}\\\hline\text{Market}&0820&0915\\\text{Station}&0845&0940\end{array}$.
When does B2 reach Station?

options.why: Reads the B2 departure from Market instead of its Station arrival.
Reads the Station time from the B1 column instead of B2.

questions.solution_text:
Read the Station row and B2 column.
B2 reaches Station at $0940$.

questions.question_text:
Use $\begin{array}{c|cc} &\text{C1}&\text{C2}\\\hline\text{Start}&1240&1315\\\text{Finish}&1330&1400\end{array}$.
How long does C1 take?

options.why: Subtracts the displayed minute numbers without accounting for the change of hour.
Uses only the minutes from 1:00 to 1:30 and omits the first 20 minutes.
Reads the first service column, whose arrival is 0830.
Reads the third service column, whose arrival is 0940.

questions.solution_text:
Find $0905$ in the Arrive row and read its column heading.
The service is **S2**.

questions.question_text:
Use $\begin{array}{c|cc}\text{Session}&\text{Start}&\text{Finish}\\\hline\text{Art}&1535&1645\\\text{Music}&1700&1810\end{array}$.
What is the Art start time in 12-hour notation?

options.why: Subtracts 10 instead of 12 from hour 15, giving 5, but keeps the correct pm label.
Converts the hour correctly but labels every 24-hour time as am.
Subtracts 10 instead of 12 from hour 15 and also labels the time as am.
Treats the latest same-day arrival as crossing midnight while ignoring 00-hour arrivals.
Recognises one 00-hour arrival but overlooks that F2 also arrives after midnight.
Includes F1 even though it arrives at 2330 before midnight.

questions.solution_text:
Arrivals $0010$ and $0045$ occur on the next day.
F2 and F3 cross midnight.

questions.question_text:
Use $\begin{array}{c|ccc} &\text{A}&\text{B}&\text{C}\\\hline\text{Leave}&1010&1040&1115\\\text{Arrive}&1120&1135&1200\end{array}$.
Which service has the shortest journey?

options.why: Chooses the earliest departure without comparing each service's elapsed time.
Calculates B's 55 minutes but overlooks C's shorter 45-minute trip.

questions.solution_text:
A takes $70$ minutes.
B takes $55$ minutes.
C takes $45$ minutes.
Service C has the shortest journey.
